_readme: Hand-judged relevance set. This is NOT derived from the category column — it's an independent judgment of 'would a listener who likes the anchor actually enjoy this recommendation'. grade 2 = excellent match (same singer/style/mood/production, you'd put it on the same playlist without thinking), grade 1 = decent/related (some real overlap but a noticeably weaker match, or right mood/wrong energy), anything not listed = grade 0 (not a relevant recommendation for this anchor). This file was DRAFTED by an AI reviewing the track list, not verified by ear against the actual audio — the project owner should listen and correct entries before trusting scores computed from it. Edit freely: add anchors, change grades, remove judgments you disagree with.

anchors.note: Classic Jagjit Singh ghazal — sparse harmonium/sarangi, restrained vocal, melancholic/sad mood specifically (owner correction: Hoshwalon Ko Khabar Kya is a more romantic-mood ghazal by the same singer, so it's a decent but not excellent match on mood; Gulon Mein Rang Bhare doesn't fit well enough to include at all).
Badshah-style EDM/hip-hop Bollywood party track — rap verses, synth-heavy, fast.

Owner correction: Afreen Afreen is more of a romantic sufi song than a hard qawwali and doesn't belong in this cluster (it stays judged under the Kun Faya Kun anchor instead, where it fits better).
